scripts.text:
DELETE FROM dw.FactSales;
DELETE FROM dw.DimCustomer;

INSERT INTO dw.DimCustomer (
    CustomerID,
    CustomerType,
    FirstName,
    LastName,
    MiddleName,
    Age
)
SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    CASE 
        WHEN c.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Person'
        WHEN c.StoreID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Store'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS CustomerType,
    p.First_Name,
    p.Last_Name,
    p.Middle_Name,
    p.Age
FROM wrk.Customer c
LEFT JOIN wrk.Person p
    ON c.PersonID = p.BusinessEntityID;

DELETE FROM dw.FactSales;
DELETE FROM dw.DimDate;

WITH DateCTE AS (
SELECT CAST('2010-01-01' AS DATE) AS TheDate
UNION ALL
SELECT DATEADD(DAY, 1, TheDate)
FROM DateCTE
WHERE TheDate < '2030-12-31'
)
INSERT INTO dw.DimDate (
DateKey,
FullDate,
DayNumberOfMonth,
MonthNumber,
MonthName,
QuarterNumber,
YearNumber
)
SELECT
CAST(FORMAT(TheDate, 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT),
TheDate,
DAY(TheDate),
MONTH(TheDate),
DATENAME(MONTH, TheDate),
DATEPART(QUARTER, TheDate),
YEAR(TheDate)
FROM DateCTE
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 0);

source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
    t.TABLE_SCHEMA AS schema_name,
    t.TABLE_NAME   AS table_name
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES t
WHERE TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE'
  AND (t.TABLE_SCHEMA + '.' + t.TABLE_NAME) IN (
        'Sales.SalesOrderDetail',
        'Sales.Customer',
        'Person.Person',
        'Sales.Store',
        'Production.Product',
        'Production.ProductCategory',
        'Sales.SalesTerritory'
  )
ORDER BY t.TABLE_SCHEMA, t.TABLE_NAME;

SELECT
    t.TABLE_SCHEMA AS schema_name,
    t.TABLE_NAME   AS table_name
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES t
WHERE TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE'
  AND (t.TABLE_SCHEMA + '.' + t.TABLE_NAME) IN (
        'stg.SalesOrderDetail',
        'stg.Customer',
        'stg.Person',
        'stg.Store',
        'stg.Product',
        'stg.ProductCategory',
        'stg.ProductSubcategory',
         'stg.SalesOrderHeader',
        'stg.SalesTerritory'
  )
ORDER BY t.TABLE_SCHEMA, t.TABLE_NAME;

scripts.text:
DELETE FROM dw.FactSales;
DELETE FROM dw.DimProduct;

INSERT INTO dw.DimProduct (
    ProductID,
    ProductName,
    ProductNumber,
    Color_Imputed,
    StandardCost,
    ListPrice,
    ProductSubcategoryID,
    ProductSubcategoryName,
    ProductCategoryID,
    ProductCategoryName
)
SELECT
    p.ProductID,
    p.Name AS ProductName,
    p.ProductNumber,
    p.Color_Imputed,
    p.StandardCost,
    p.ListPrice,
    ps.ProductSubcategoryID,
    ps.Name AS ProductSubcategoryName,
    pc.ProductCategoryID,
    pc.Name AS ProductCategoryName
FROM wrk.product_new p
LEFT JOIN stg.ProductSubcategory ps
    ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = ps.ProductSubcategoryID
LEFT JOIN stg.ProductCategory pc
    ON ps.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID;

DELETE FROM dw.FactSales;
DELETE FROM dw.DimTerritory;

INSERT INTO dw.DimTerritory (
    TerritoryID,
    TerritoryName,
    CountryRegionCode,
    TerritoryGroup
)
SELECT
    TerritoryID,
    Name AS TerritoryName,
    CountryRegionCode,
    [Group] AS TerritoryGroup
FROM stg.SalesTerritory;

TRUNCATE TABLE dw.FactSales;

INSERT INTO dw.FactSales
(
    SalesOrderID,
    SalesOrderDetailID,
    OrderDateKey,
    CustomerKey,
    ProductKey,
    TerritoryKey,
    OrderQty,
    UnitPrice,
    UnitPriceDiscount,
    LineTotal
)
SELECT
    f.SalesOrderID,
    f.SalesOrderDetailID,
    dd.DateKey,
    dc.CustomerKey,
    dp.ProductKey,
    dt.TerritoryKey,
    f.OrderQty,
    f.UnitPrice,
    f.UnitPriceDiscount,
    f.LineTotal
FROM wrk.pre_fact f
LEFT JOIN dw.DimCustomer dc
    ON f.CustomerID = dc.CustomerID
LEFT JOIN dw.DimProduct dp
    ON f.ProductID = dp.ProductID
LEFT JOIN dw.DimDate dd
    ON CAST(f.OrderDate AS DATE) = dd.FullDate
LEFT JOIN dw.DimTerritory dt
    ON f.TerritoryID = dt.TerritoryID
WHERE dc.CustomerKey IS NOT NULL
  AND dp.ProductKey IS NOT NULL
  AND dd.DateKey IS NOT NULL
  AND dt.TerritoryKey IS NOT NULL;
